message.content:
This editorial illustration for the magazine "TEMPO" features a vertical layout on an orange background. In the foreground, a man with brown skin, a black cap, and a black military-style uniform walks toward the left. He holds a silver-colored flag pole with both hands. Attached to the pole is a white flag featuring a red bird emblem and the word "JAYA." Behind him, a large, dark brown shadow looms. The shadow's shape depicts a larger, saluting human figure with a rounded body and hair. 

At the top, large white block letters spell "TEMPO" with "53" appearing within the "O." Above this, text in Indonesian reads "Menteri Jokowi di Ujung Tanduk H.30" and "Modus Manipulasi Keuangan eFishery H.80." To the left of the central figure, the bold black text "OKE GAS, HERCULES" is followed by a paragraph of smaller text. The bottom left contains a QR code, a barcode with "9 770126 427302," and publication details: "12-18 MEI 2025," "RP 60.000," "TEMPO.CO/MINGGUAN," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273."
